name: Vector-Matrix (VM) Decomposition
definition: A novel decomposition technique that relaxes the low-rank constraints for two modes of a tensor by factorizing it into compact vector and matrix factors, effectively acting as a special case of Block Term Decomposition (BTD).
summary: Vector-Matrix Decomposition reduces memory by factorizing tensors into vector-matrix outer products, relaxing low-rank constraints to express complex data more efficiently than pure vector methods.
